integer_rule: all sums use overflow-checked non-negative integers and reject values not exactly representable by the implementation
memory_rule: initial-shared-memory and maximum-shared-memory must be equal, page-aligned, and no greater than their limits; memory growth is outside the POC
content_encoding_rule: HTTP content decoding never substitutes for release expansion accounting; count the representation delivered to the loader and separately count every expanded release member
scope_rule: these are experimental safety ceilings, not product acceptance budgets
